1000 (Tysiacha/Tysiąc) is a point-trick marriage game well known across Eastern Europe—Russia, Belarus, Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Poland, and Lithuania. In Russian it is Tysiacha (Тысяча), in Polish Tysiąc; both mean 'thousand,' the target score. Slight rule variations exist between and within countries; the Polish form Tysiąc licytowany (Auction 1000) is widely played as Poland's national card game.
